code_change.summary: Бейджи и матрица CI версий рассогласованы с requires-python=3.11 — README врёт о поддержке 3.8.
code_change.diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,1 +3,1 @@
-![python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue)
+![python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-blue)
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -10,3 +10,3 @@ jobs:
     strategy:
       matrix:
-        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10"]
+        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]

docs_change.human_written_text:
### Supported versions

The project is tested on Python 3.11 and 3.12 only. The badge and the CI
matrix were both out of date: `pyproject.toml` declares `requires-python =
">=3.11"`, so installations on 3.8–3.10 fail at import time even though the old
badge advertised them.

notes: Кейс 'код меняется, а README отстаёт' — главный сценарий ценности системы. Требует cross-file проверки (CI x pyproject x README).
